title: redstono's toy stick
description: this mod adds the toy stick from hypixel. when you right click on it, it shoots a projectile that explodes on impact.
body:
Key Features:
-the toy stick from hypixel. when you right click on it, it shoots a projectile that explodes on impact. this item is a Knockback Powerhouse – Sends foes flying like balloons with exaggerated knockback. perfect for turning your world into something worse then 2b2t
